name: Chetreya
source:
Chetreya (full name is Chetreya Amtingale) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
A matured azure green-eyed om'verai with long blue mane big head fins, decorated with green earrings. Big eyes have large "eyebrows" above" and belly plates are dark-blue.
Few is known about Chetreya, but she seems to be a caring wife & mother.
